name: WASTE COLLECTION BOX
shortDescription:
FOR DISPOSAL OF USED/BLUNDERED TIPS.
SAMMELBOX (WASTE TIP JAR) can be filled with used tips in SAFEBOX or can be used directly. When this plastic jar is full, the lid is turned all the way to ensure complete locking. This way, it is ensured that it will not open again. All jars full of waste tips can be disposed of collectively via household waste in this way. Click for more information .
seoDescription: SafeBox for safe collection and disposal of used blades. Lockable lid ensures secure containment and easy waste management. Durable and safe.

name: Connector Set
shortDescription:
SAFE CUTTING WITH A DISTANCE. THE PERFECT COMBINATION.
Sometimes the object to be cut can be too high or too far away, so it can be difficult to reach it. MARTOR's new CONNECTOR SET helps you to overcome distances when cutting. It consists of the CONNECTOR unit, which can be easily and firmly combined with our SECUMAX 350, 350 SE, 150 and 148 safety blades, and the MARTOR brand TELESCOPIC BAR. With this set you gain an additional 95 cm of coverage. Click for more information.
seoDescription: Extends reach of SECUMAX 350/150 knives by 95cm with telescopic pole. Ideal for cutting high or distant objects safely. Ergonomic design.

name: Belt Bag L
shortDescription:
VERYTHING AT HANDS AT ALL TIMES: BELT POUCH L.
Where to store cutting tools when you don't need them? The sturdy BELT POUCH L holds all large MARTOR knives as well as our small scissors. Even more: Additional internal and external slots allow flexible placement of, for example, another knife, a pen or a knife packaging. This way, you can transport your work materials safely from A to B in your BELT POUCH and pack them up quickly when you go. Click for more information.
seoDescription: Durable nylon belt bag for large MARTOR knives and scissors. Multiple slots for flexible tool organization. Comfortable and practical.

name: Belt Bag M
shortDescription:
ALWAYS EVERYTHING AT HANDS: BELT POUCH M.
The sturdy BELT POUCH M accommodates all medium-sized MARTOR knives as well as our small scissors. Even more: Additional inner and outer slots allow flexible placement of e.g. another knife, a pen or a knife packaging. Click for more information.
seoDescription: Sturdy belt pouch for medium-sized MARTOR knives and accessories. Inner and outer pockets for versatile storage. Ideal for daily use.

name: Belt Bag S
shortDescription:
ALWAYS HAVE EVERYTHING AT HANDS: BELT POUCH S.
The robust BELT POUCH S holds all robust MARTOR knives and our small scissors. Even more: Additional slots for squeezing in a pencil or knife pack can be flexibly positioned. Click for more information.
seoDescription: Compact nylon belt bag for smaller MARTOR knives. Flexible slots for pens and knife packs. Lightweight and easy to carry.

name: Belt Bag XXL
shortDescription:
LARGE SPACE. WIDE OPTIONS.
The XXL BELT POUCH is a real space monster. With it, you can not only transport your MARTOR cutting tools safely from A to B. At the same time, all your working tools are always at hand. The XXL BELT POUCH has two large compartments: The inner compartment can be closed, the outer compartment has a knife safety. You are also well-equipped in terms of carrying options. Choose flexibly between belt, velcro and clip.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Large capacity belt bag with two main compartments for carrying multiple MARTOR tools safely. Durable and designed for professionals.

name: SECUMAX 145
shortDescription:
SIMPLE FORM. POWERFUL PERFORMANCE.
The SECUMAX 145 is our small, precise safety knife for everyday cutting. The glass fibre reinforced plastic handle and the 0.5 mm thick tip provide significant sturdiness. It also weighs only 12 g. Our disposable knife easily cuts single-layer cardboard, foil or adhesive tape. Thanks to its two protected cutting edges, your fingers are particularly protected. Click for more information.
seoDescription: Lightweight (12g) safety knife for everyday cutting. Glass fiber handle, 2-way disposable tip for cardboard and foil. Comfortable and safe.

name: SECUMAX 145 MDP
shortDescription:
SIMPLE FORM. POWERFUL PERFORMANCE. METAL DETECTOR DETECTABLE.
The SECUMAX 145 is our small, precise safety knife for everyday cutting tasks – also available as an MDP model. Thanks to the metal detector-detectable plastic handle and the 0.5 mm thick tip, it provides significant durability at a light weight of 14 grams. Its concealed cutting tips easily cut single layers of cardboard, foil or adhesive tape without getting close to you. The SECUMAX 145 MDP is re-findable, so your company is well protected.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Lightweight metal-detectable safety knife. Ideal for food/pharma industries. 2-way disposable tip ensures hygiene and safety in production.

name: SECUMAX 150 MDP
shortDescription:
THREE TIMES AWARDED WITH THE HIGHEST SCORE. DETECTABLE BY METAL DETECTORS.
The SECUMAX 150 MDP performs several functions at once. High security: The hidden cutting edge does not touch you or your products. Versatility: With it, you can cut, scrape or score without needing a second blade. The biggest benefit for customers: Especially for sensitive sectors, the SECUNORM 150 MDP blade is made of metal-detectable plastic and is therefore always retrievable. Click for more information.
seoDescription: Award-winning metal-detectable safety knife. Combines cutting, scraping, and scoring in one multi-functional tool. Versatile and durable.

name: SECUMAX 320
shortDescription:
COMBI RELOADED. THE NEW GENERATION.
The SECUMAX COMBI was always a first-class foil specialist: right up until it was dethroned by its legitimate successor. The new SECUMAX 320 COMBI stands out at first glance with its unusual design. At second glance, you will also notice the quality inside. For example, the improved ergonomics compared to its predecessor or the re-rounded tip change. But what about the topic of “maximum work safety”? It has always been part of the COMBI DNA: and it remains so.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Next-gen foil cutting specialist with improved ergonomics. 4-way interchangeable tip for versatile use. Designed for professional needs.

name: SECUMAX 320 MDP
shortDescription: The SECUMAX COMBI MDP was always a first-class foil specialist: right up until it was dethroned by its legitimate successor. The new SECUMAX 320 MDP COMBI stands out at first glance with its unusual design. At second glance, you will also notice the quality inside. For example, the improved ergonomics compared to its predecessor or the re-rounded tip change. But what about the topic of “metal detectability”? It has always been part of the COMBI-MDP-DNA: and it will remain so. Click for more information.
seoDescription: Metal-detectable version of the SECUMAX 320. Ideal for sensitive production environments. Safe and reliable for critical applications.

name: SECUMAX 350
shortDescription:
WORK TURNED INTO FUN? TRY IT.
The SECUMAX 350 combines versatility, comfort and maximum safety. The SECUMAX 350 is a real all-rounder and has an innovative blade change feature. It cuts everything from frequently cut materials to foil, plastic rings and double-layered cardboard. It feels so good that you can't even put it down. Click for more information.
seoDescription: Versatile safety knife with innovative blade change system. Cuts foil, plastic, and cardboard with ease. Comfortable and user-friendly.

name: SECUMAX 363
shortDescription:
IT DOES MILLIMETRIC WORK. IN MANY FIELDS.
Our safety scissors for extremely precise and accurate cuts. You can easily manage it with your fingers. Like its “big brothers” SECUMAX 564 and 565, it is also lightweight and easily cuts cardboard, paper, foil, fabric, rope and hoops. Thanks to the special grinding and sharpened tips of the cutting edges, hands and fingers are protected against injury.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Precision safety scissors for detailed work. Sharpened, rounded tips protect against injury while cutting. Ideal for precise operations.

name: SECUMAX 564
shortDescription:
ESPECIALLY SUCCESSFUL IN LONG CUTTING.
The SECUMAX 564 stands out with its extra-long cutting tip, which also has a thumb opening and an ideal seating surface. This way, you can work with the safety scissors in a highly controlled manner. A few cuts are enough to pierce cardboard, paper, foil, fabric and more. Maximum safety is ensured thanks to the special grinding and sharpened tips of the cutting tips. Click for more information.
seoDescription: Long-blade safety scissors perfect for extended cuts. Precision-ground tips for maximum safety and control. Ergonomic and practical design.

name: SECUMAX 565
shortDescription:
MULTI-PURPOSE. AT WORK AND AT HOME.
Our multi-purpose tool for professional cutting. Ideal for large hands – or when working with gloves. Cardboard, paper, foil, fabric and much more cannot withstand its powerful cuts. However, thanks to the special grinding and rounded tips, you are optimally protected. The additional wire notch can be used to cut wires and cables, and the claw can be used to open covers.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Multi-purpose safety scissors for heavy-duty cutting. Features wire notch and claw for opening covers. Durable and reliable performance.

name: SECUMAX CARDYCUT
shortDescription:
N PLACES WHERE OTHERS CANNOT REACH. WHITE AND STAINLESS.
SECUMAX CARDYCUT white can also be used as a custom printable promotional knife and is in demand. Thanks to its compact design and short nose, you can easily maneuver it: for example, in curved cuts and especially in narrow gaps. It is often used in the automotive industry, for example, as it specializes in thin, single-layer foils.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Compact safety knife for tight spaces and curved cuts. Ideal for single-layer foils in automotive. Lightweight and easy to handle.

name: SECUMAX EASYSAFE
shortDescription:
VERY EASY, VERY SAFE.
The SECUMAX EASYSAFE is a multi-talent. The pointed plastic nose cuts through shrink wrap or stretch film, allowing it to reach the blade tip. The Solingen quality blade will cut through these materials with ease. The integrated clamping bracket makes it easy to cut thin foils and paper lines – even in individual layers. But what about thin textiles or plastic strapping strips? No problem for the concealed cutter.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Versatile safety knife with pointed nose for piercing film. Hidden blade for secure cutting. Perfect for packaging applications.

name: SECUMAX RING CUTTER MDP
shortDescription:
LITTLE HELPER. DETECTABLE BY METAL DETECTORS.
Do you work with a cutting tool and still have both hands free for other tasks? This is only possible with the SECUMAX RING KNIFE MDP ring knife. With this ring on your finger, you can cut foils, ropes, strings and much more, and if you happen to drop it somewhere, the ring knife is made of metal-detector-detectable plastic, which minimizes the risk of it interfering with your production process as an intruder.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Finger ring safety knife. Metal-detectable plastic ensures safety, cuts strings and films effortlessly. Innovative and user-friendly design.

name: SECUMAX OPTICUT
shortDescription:
SLIDES OVER AND THROUGH THE MATERIAL. FOR PRESSURE CUTTING.
Are you looking for a polystyrene knife that effortlessly cuts through harder and stronger foils and is not afraid of stubborn polystyrene? The SECUMAX OPTICUT offers you the ideal solution. Its sliding foot made of teflon-coated metal not only makes it extremely resistant to wear, but also allows you to move it easily on the subfloor. Click for more information.
seoDescription: Polystyrene knife with Teflon-coated base. Slides smoothly, ideal for pressure cutting of tough materials. Professional and durable tool.

name: SECUMAX PLASTICUT
shortDescription:
ALSO ABLE TO CUT MULTIPLE LAYERS.
SECUMAX PLASTICUT differs from the other products in our range only in the details. But you know: That's the point. Thanks to the wide gap between the tip and the plastic, this safety knife can also move through several layers, e.g. foil and paper. Considering the wall thickness of 3 mm, it is also possible to make curved cuts with fine intervals. Also: Until the new face of the cutting tool, it was called SECUMAX POLYPICK. Click for more information.
seoDescription: Safety knife for multi-layer cutting. Perfect for precise, curved cuts in plastic and film. Lightweight and easy to control.

name: SECUMAX POLYCUT
shortDescription:
A SUPERIOR AMONG THE EXPERTS.
SECUMAX POLYCUT is among our small, agile disposable knives made of plastic. But it still has a special place here as a superior knife. Thanks to the slightly wider gap between the tip and the plastic, you can also cut thin materials in several layers. Because its nose is extra long and pointed, try opening envelopes or cutting foils in narrow strips with it. Thanks to its narrow structure, it works expertly in narrow spaces. Click for more information.
seoDescription: Disposable safety knife for narrow spaces. Cuts single and multi-layered thin materials with precision. Hygienic and cost-effective.

name: SECUMAX SALVEX SOS
shortDescription:
FIRST AID KNIFE AND HAMMER IN ONE.
In the event of an accident, it is necessary to act quickly and calmly. A multi-purpose first aid knife can even be a lifesaver. To save the injured person, you can first break the side window of the vehicle with SECUMAX SALVEX. You can use the hidden cutting tip to cut the seat belt and remove clothes. It is a good feeling to help!Click for more information.
seoDescription: 2-in-1 rescue knife with glass breaker and seatbelt cutter. Compact and ready for emergencies. Essential for vehicle safety kits.

name: SECUNORM 380
shortDescription:
WE PRODUCED FOR THE WORLD OF SPECIAL REQUESTS.
How can a long-opening blade still be safe? This has been a long-discussed contradiction. SECUNORM 380 has put an end to these discussions, opening over 4 cm and earning the status of the world's safest knife, deserving this trust. The safety system prevents the blade from coming out of the handle, so you don't have to intervene. Click for more information.
seoDescription: Semi-automatic safety knife with over 4cm blade extension. One of the world's safest designs. Built for demanding professional use.

name: SECUNORM 500
shortDescription:
SAFE BLADE. WITH CERAMIC BLADE.
The SECUNORM PROFI has set standards in safety, durability and ergonomics for over 40 years. Its successor has set new standards. The newly designed aluminium handle has been developed for a better grip and comfortable working. The new two-sided slider, the pre-mounted ceramic blade. Or changing the blade, which has now become very easy. The high-quality automatic blade retraction during cutting protects against cut injuries.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Aluminum safety knife with ceramic blade. Auto-retraction ensures high safety and durability. Premium quality and ergonomic design.

name: SECUNORM 540
shortDescription:
ESPECIALLY EXPERT – IN MANY FIELDS. STAINLESS STEEL TIPPED.
Thanks to a cutting depth of up to 36 mm, the SECUNORM 540 meets all the requirements of its field. Especially when it comes to foam, stereopor, paper tape and bagged products, the MARTOR safety knives demonstrate their impressive power. Despite all their specialist features, the robust and ergonomic aluminium handle is still easy to use and fits every hand. The proven automatic blade retraction mechanism protects against cutting injuries even during cutting.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Deep-cutting aluminum knife for foam and sacks. 36mm depth with auto blade retraction. Comfortable and efficient for industrial use.

name: SECUNORM 610 XDR
shortDescription:
UNAFFETED BY DUST. WITH A SPECIAL ROUND-SHAPED BLADE TIP.
The SECUNORM 610 XDR is the first universal bag opener that cuts effectively AND safely. With it, you can open bags of all types and thicknesses. No matter what is inside the bag. Because “XDR” stands for eXtra Dirt Resistant, meaning: Even dusty, liquid or sticky contents cannot stop the safety blade. The blade tip retracts as soon as you release the handle after cutting. This protects you from cut injuries.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Dust-resistant universal bag opener. 32mm cutting depth, MDP option for sensitive industries. Durable and reliable performance.

name: SECUNORM HANDY
shortDescription:
POCKETABLE CLASSIC DESIGN.
Don't let the compact appearance of the SECUNORM HANDY fool you. Handy doesn't mean cute, on the contrary, this knife is a "toothed" cutting tool that provides all the quality your job requires. On the one hand, you'll be happy because you can use the cutting edge and handle for a long time, and on the other hand, your safe knife is good at cutting all materials.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Pocket-sized semi-automatic safety knife. Steel construction with 4-way interchangeable tip. Lightweight and always ready for use.

name: SECUNORM HANDY MDP
shortDescription: Don't let the compact appearance of the SECUNORM HANDY MDP (with metal detector) fool you. Handy doesn't mean cute, on the contrary, this "toothed" cutting tool provides all the quality your work requires. If you produce food or medicine, the MDP option should be your first choice. Because the metal detector-detectable plastic and stainless steel feature guarantee that the SECUNORM HANDY MDP will not cause any danger.Click for more information.

rows: Metal detector detectable plastic, Stainless steel

seoDescription: Metal-detectable compact safety knife. Steel and stainless construction for high-risk areas. Ideal for food and pharmaceutical sectors.

name: SECUNORM MIZAR
shortDescription:
HIGHER PERFORMANCE HANDLE. ROUND TRAPEZE TIP.
With the comfortable SECUNORM MIZAR you enter the world of our high-quality pliers-handled knives. Instead of a slider, this tool has an easy-to-use handle that releases the cutting edge. You can use the knife in a very versatile and efficient way. Thanks to its large cutting depth, it can be used in all wide and common materials. The handle is made of at least 50% recycled plastic.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Semi-automatic knife with handle release. Glass-fiber handle, comfortable and powerful. Designed for precision and control.

name: SECUNORM MULTISAFE
shortDescription:
EAVY METAL IN BRIEF. TRAPEZE TIP.
Made of zinc, the SECUNORM MULTISAFE is an “Evergreen” with a completely renewed design. It has an extraordinary strength due to its unpretentious and stable design. Thanks to its large tip output, you can cut all common materials with it. Or, if necessary, equip your safety knife with one of our many optional tips.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Heavy-duty zinc safety knife with a large tip opening. Ideal for robust applications. Durable, ergonomic, and built for tough tasks.

name: SECUNORM PROFI25 MDP
shortDescription:
READY FOR USE EVERY TIME. DETECTABLE BY METAL DETECTOR. ROUND TRAPEZE TIP.
The choice of the name SECUNORM PROFI25 MDP is not a coincidence. “PROFI” because it is a professional product for most cutting materials and cutting applications. “25” because the cutting depth is 25 mm. It can easily cut 3-layer corrugated cardboard. MDP because all plastic parts are detected by metal detectors.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Metal-detectable knife with 25mm cutting depth. Cuts 3-layer cardboard with ease. Perfect for logistics and packaging operations.

name: SECUNORM PROFI40 MDP
shortDescription:
DEEP CUT. HIGH QUALITY. DETECTABLE BY METAL DETECTORS.
SECUNORM PROFI 40 MDP is also a real PROFI knife. Like many different types of sacks, bags. As it is known, this process requires deep cutting. With its 40 mm blade, SECUNORM PROFI40 MDP is therefore a very good choice. It is also detectable by metal detectors as it is unpainted. Ideal for sectors that want to prevent problems due to foreign objects in production.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Deep-cutting, metal-detectable knife with 40mm blade. Ideal for opening sacks and bags. High performance for demanding applications.

name: SECUNORM SMARTCUT MDP
shortDescription: As soon as you hold the SECUNORM SMARTCUT MDP (with metal detector) in your hand, you will immediately understand why the word SMART is emphasized. Smart because it is lighter and more compact. Or because it is suitable for almost all materials to be cut. SMART because you can use it with complete peace of mind in sectors with sensitive production processes. Because its handle is made of metal detector-detectable plastic and its cutting edge is made of stainless steel. Good to know, isn't it?Click for more information.
seoDescription: Lightweight, compact MDP knife. Disposable tip, ideal for cutting all materials in sensitive areas. Reliable and hygienic solution.

name: SECUPLUS RIPPEX 210
shortDescription:
PAPER SEPARATION WITHOUT A BLADE – IN INDIVIDUAL LAYERS.
The SECUPLUS RIPPEX 210 is ideal for processing roll-type products. Thanks to a narrow plastic burr on the upper side, this separator can separate individual paper layers from the roll. Since there is no blade, cutting injuries are not possible. Material loss is also limited. Because the ergonomic SECUPLUS RIPPEX 210 not only inserts itself precisely into the desired layer. It also moves over the floor without leaving any traces.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Safe, blade-free paper separator. Separates individual layers from rolls without injury risk. Innovative and user-friendly design.

name: SECUPLUS RIPPEX 220
shortDescription:
PAPER SEPARATION WITHOUT A BLADE – IN SEVERAL LAYERS.
The SECUPLUS RIPPEX 220 is ideal for processing roll-type products. Thanks to its robust upper edge, this separator can separate individual or multiple paper layers from the roll. Since there is no blade, cutting injuries are not possible. Material loss is also limited. Because the extremely ergonomic SECUPLUS RIPPEX 220 not only inserts itself precisely into the desired layer. It also moves over the floor without leaving any traces. Click for more information.
seoDescription: Blade-free paper separator for rolls. Separates single or multiple layers safely. Efficient and risk-free separation solution.

name: SECUPRO 625
shortDescription:
LONG TRIGGER. LONG BLADE TIP. LONG PLEASURE IN USE.
The SECUPRO 625 WITH STAINLESS, ROUNDED TRAPEZOIDAL BLADE TIP is at the top of our ergonomic pliers-handled knives. Its claim is clear: Premium. Because it embodies the common desire of all professional users: an aluminium handle. A stainless steel trigger that easily triggers the blade tip. A very large cutting depth and with it a fully automatic blade return. Comfortable blade change. And all this with the feeling of holding a top-quality High-End tool in your hand.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Premium aluminum safety knife with a long stainless steel trigger. Auto-retracting for safety. Designed for professional and heavy use.

name: SECUPRO MARTEGO
shortDescription:
TO THE HIGHEST EXPECTATIONS. CERAMIC BLADE.
A cutting tool where functionality and design go hand in hand? That's our award-winning SECUPRO MARTEGO, a pliers-grip knife with fully automatic blade retraction. Get used to the word "very" when you're around it, because it's very safe, very durable, very ergonomic, versatile and made to a very high standard. The MARTOR ceramic blade used is also very sharp and very durable.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Award-winning ceramic blade knife. Fully automatic retraction. Durable and high-performance. Ideal for demanding industrial environments.

name: SECUPRO MAXISAFE
shortDescription:
PERFECT USE IN ALL DIRECTIONS. ROUND TRAPEZE TIP.
For over 15 years, the SECUPRO MAXISAFE has proven its superiority thanks to its lightness and wide range of use. The safety knife has now reached a new level of ergonomics. Just pick it up and press the completely renewed 3-sided slider… Can you feel the difference? Here, you don’t have to compromise on qualities such as fully automatic blade retraction or a sturdy handle made of high-quality plastic.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Lightweight safety knife with 17mm cutting depth. Auto-retraction for maximum safety and comfort. Reliable and ergonomic tool.

name: SECUPRO MEGASAFE
shortDescription:
AS HIGH QUALITY AS IT LOOKS. STAINLESS STEEL TRAPEZE TIPPED.
Do you want a safety knife with a long blade? Or are you looking for a cutting tool for the toughest uses? In both cases, the SECUPRO MEGASAFE is the perfect choice. With a cutting depth of 20 mm, it shys away from no difficult task. Your safety is always guaranteed, as the fully automatic blade retraction mechanism maintains its functionality even with the blade not fully extended.Click for more information.
seoDescription: Heavy-duty aluminum safety knife. Ideal for tough uses with a 20mm cutting depth. Durable and built for challenging tasks.

name: SECUPRO MERAK
shortDescription:
SAFETY, COMFORT? EVERYTHING UNDER CONTROL WITH THE DOUBLE LOCK.
SECUPRO MERAK is our practical pliers-grip knife with fully automatic blade retraction. When designing the «little brother» of SECUPRO MARTEGO, we had one thing in mind first: You. Because with the lightweight and user-friendly SECUPRO MERAK, you will work very safely and without tiring under all conditions. In addition, your product will be protected thanks to the low cutting depth. It doesn’t matter what material you are cutting. Click for more information.
seoDescription: Lightweight safety knife with double lock. Fully automatic retraction for enhanced safety. Comfortable and reliable for daily use.

name: TOOL RETRACTOR
shortDescription:
YOUR CUTTING TOOL IS ALWAYS WITH YOU.
The TOOL RETRACTOR protects your cutting tool from getting lost or falling down. The main part here is the extremely durable and removable Kevlar thread, up to 90 cm. As soon as you let go of your knives, they are brought back to you via the flexible thread. You can use your hands for other tasks – the knife always remains at hand. The carabiner loop is intended for your belt loop, while the steel rope at the other end is intended for the eye of your cutting tool. Click for more information.
seoDescription: 90cm retractable tether for MARTOR knives. Prevents falls, keeps tools accessible. Essential for workplace safety and efficiency.

name: Antistatic Cables
shortDescription: Prevents sparks that may be created by the movement of flammable-combustible liquids or static electricity originating from the fluid.
descriptionHtml: Prevents sparks that may be created by the movement of flammable-combustible liquids or static electricity originating from the fluid.
seoDescription: Prevents sparks caused by static electricity during liquid transfer. Essential for safety in flammable environments. Reliable and effective.

name: Bench Can
shortDescription: Used for cleaning small parts with solvent. Perforated table is spring supported, minimizes contact with hand. You can label large surface areas.
descriptionHtml: Used for cleaning small parts with solvent. Perforated table is spring supported, minimizes contact with hand. You can label large surface areas.
seoDescription: Spring-loaded safety can for solvent cleaning. Minimizes hand contact with chemicals. Practical and safe solution for maintenance tasks.

name: Safety Can (Polyethylene)
shortDescription: It has the same basic features as Type 1 containers. The emptying process can be made more precise with the tap at the bottom. Metal parts are stainless steel.
descriptionHtml: It has the same basic features as Type 1 containers. The emptying process can be made more precise with the tap at the bottom. Metal parts are stainless steel.

rows: 1 galon (4 L) güvenli kap, kendinden kapanan 08919 vana ile.

seoDescription: Polyethylene safety can with a bottom tap. Stainless steel parts for corrosive liquids. Durable and chemical-resistant design.

name: Industrial Ashtrays
shortDescription:
Justrite Industrial Ashtrays, which are an ideal product for building entrances and smoking areas, are FM globally approved.
The innovative Cease-Fire design aims to limit oxygen flow, reduce fire risk, easily extinguish cigarettes and reduce the chimney effect seen in similar products. The aesthetic product can be offered to you in different colors.
descriptionHtml:
Justrite Industrial Ashtrays, which are an ideal product for building entrances and smoking areas, are FM globally approved.
The innovative Cease-Fire design aims to limit oxygen flow, reduce fire risk, easily extinguish cigarettes and reduce the chimney effect seen in similar products. The aesthetic product can be offered to you in different colors.
seoDescription: FM-approved ash trays with Cease-Fire design. Reduces fire risk, perfect for building entrances. Stylish, durable, and safety-focused.

name: Spill Containment Pallet
shortDescription: Barrels, tanks or cans can be stacked safely with these products, which are offered in various sizes and capacities.
descriptionHtml: With these products offered in various sizes and capacities, barrel, tank or canister stacking is done safely. Thanks to their reservoirs, in case of leakage during liquid transfer (with a transfer pump or valve) or in case of an accident (forklift crash, a punctured barrel, etc.), the liquid remains in the pallet reservoir. In such a case, the barrel causing the leak is removed from the environment. The pallet's grid is lifted and the liquid in the reservoir is eliminated with a pump or absorbent materials.

name: Dispensing Cans
shortDescription: Polyethylene Pour Cups allow easy one-handed pouring of liquid. FM approved, these brass valves are recommended for flammable liquids.
descriptionHtml:
Polyethylene Pour Cups allow easy one-handed pouring of liquid. FM approved, these brass valves are recommended for flammable liquids.
The washbasin is made of polyethylene and stainless steel material. The ball valve it contains ensures that the liquid is sprayed on the products at a minimum level. Thanks to the thin hose tip, liquid is applied to hard-to-reach places.
seoDescription: Polyethylene dispensing cans with brass valves. Easy one-handed pouring of chemicals. Practical and efficient for professional use.

name: Plunger
shortDescription: It is designed to minimize contact with liquid chemicals used in maintenance and cleaning operations. The new smart pump system provides sufficient use in cleaning operations with its brass mechanism and eliminates contact with hands.
seoDescription: Smart pump system for safe chemical dispensing. Minimizes hand contact during cleaning. Ergonomic and reliable for daily operations.

descriptionHtml: JUSTRITE POLYETHYLENE SAFE CABINETS FOR CORROSIVES
seoDescription: Corrosion-resistant polyethylene safety cabinets. For safe storage of acids and chemicals. Durable, reliable, and built for safety.

name: Uno Type 1
shortDescription: They are the most economical products offered for storing and transporting flammable chemicals. Filling and emptying are done from a single mouth.
descriptionHtml:
They are the most economical products offered for storing and transporting flammable chemicals. Filling and emptying are done from a single mouth. Thanks to the flame arrester on its mouth, it prevents sparks and flashes during filling and emptying and provides extra safety. It is steel and the inside is coated with zinc (galvanized).
Additionally, a safe and controlled discharge process can be carried out by attaching a funnel apparatus.
Polyethylene containers are available for acids and corrosive chemicals. The metal parts of these containers are made of stainless steel and there are also flame arresters on the mouth.
seoDescription: Economical galvanized steel safety can. Single opening with flame arrester for flammable liquids. Reliable and cost-effective storage.

name: Uno Type 2
shortDescription: It should be preferred for storing, transporting and pouring flammable chemicals in a controlled manner. Filling and emptying are done from a single mouth. Thanks to the flame arrester on its mouth, it prevents sparks and flashes during filling and emptying and provides extra safety. It is steel and the inside is coated with zinc (galvanized).
descriptionHtml:
It should be preferred for storing, transporting and pouring flammable chemicals in a controlled manner. Filling and emptying are done from a single mouth. Thanks to the flame arrester on its mouth, it prevents sparks and flashes during filling and emptying and provides extra safety. It is steel and the inside is coated with zinc (galvanized).
In addition, a safe and controlled discharge process is carried out with the spiral hose apparatus. The chemical is prevented from traveling in the air.
seoDescription: Galvanized steel safety can with a spiral hose. Controlled pouring of flammable chemicals. Safe and precise liquid dispensing solution.

name: Spill Containment Drum Caddy
shortDescription: Spill containment drum carts provide you with the opportunity to conveniently transport and distribute hazardous chemicals.
descriptionHtml: The spill guard drum cart offers you the opportunity to conveniently carry and distribute hazardous chemicals. Double-drawn belts allow a 200-liter drum to be carried safely. The 250-liter spill hopper prevents chemical spills and prevents them from becoming dangerous.

seoDescription: Wide-mouth funnels for 200L drums. Includes a flame arrester and self-closing lid. Safe and efficient liquid transfer solution.

name: Barrel Stacking Systems
shortDescription: Drums are easily transported on the 28663 drum trolley, which has a 250-litre spillage collection hopper.
descriptionHtml:
Drums are easily transported in the 28663 drum cart, which has a 250-litre spillage collection container. The vertical drum is approached with this cart, the cart's arms are lifted up and the drum is taken into the cart while it is vertical. After being secured with a tensioning belt, the cart is driven on its two wheels. If a leak or spill occurs during the transportation of the drum or later during the transfer of liquid, the liquid remains in the cart's tank.
In the barrel station coded 28667, two barrels can be stored horizontally. A station consisting of 4 barrels is obtained by adding the intermediate layer coded 28669. With the shelf coded 28671, other containers are safely approached to the barrel during liquid discharge.

name: SECUPRO 425
shortDescription:
Hafif ama çok etkileyici.
Hızlı ve güvenli çalışmak mı istiyorsunuz? Ekstra hafif SECUPRO 425 size bu konuda yardımcı oluyor. Emniyet bıçağı ele mükemmel oturuyor ve verimli çalışıyor. Geri dönüştürülmüş plastikten (en az %60) üretilen pense tutacağı ile çok çeşitli malzemeleri, örneğin 3 katlı kartonları ve çemberlemeleri zahmetsizce kesebilirsiniz. Tam otomatik bıçak geri çekiş özelliği de rahatlık garantisi sunuyor. Çünkü bu bıçak, kesim kazalarından sizi güvenilir bir şekilde koruyor.
seoDescription: Extra hafif, tam otomatik geri çekme mekanizmalı güvenli bıçak. 3 katlı kartonları rahatça keser. Konforlu ve yüksek performanslı.

name: SECUMAX 370
shortDescription: MARTOR’un SECUMAX 370 bıçağı, gizli bıçak ucuna ve maks. 10 mm kesim derinliğine sahip dünyanın ilk GS sertifikalı güvenlik bıçağıdır. Kesim derinliği bu zamana kadar 6 ila 7 mm’ydi – bu da örneğin üç kata varan kalın kartonları verimli kesmek için yeterli değil. MARTOR’un yenilikçi çözümü tam da burada devreye giriyor. Bu çözüm, en yüksek güvenlik sistemini esnek şekilde genişletilebilir kesim derinliğiyle kombine ediyor. Cam elyafla güçlendirilmiş tutamak, en az % 60 geri dönüştürülmüş plastikten oluşur.
seoDescription: Dünyanın ilk GS sertifikalı, 10 mm kesim derinlikli, gizli uçlu emniyetli bıçağı. geri dönüştürülmüş plastik. Çevre dostu ve güvenli.

name: SECUPLUS 567 MDP
shortDescription:
Çok uzun kesimler ve en iyi koruma için.
Metal dedektörü tarafından algılanabilir.
MARTOR’un SECUPLUS 567 MDP makası gıda, kimya ve ilaç sektörü gibi hassas sektörlere yönelik bir üniversal makastır. Sağlam ve ergonomik sapı, paslanmaz çelikten yapılmıştır. Parmak açıklıkları plastikle kaplanmıştır, plastik ise metal detektöründe yakalanabilir. 85 mm boyundaki kesim uzunluğu ile, örneğin kartonları, folyoları ve kaplamaları verimli şekilde kesebilirsiniz. Özel koruma taşlaması ve yuvarlatılmış uçlar, kesik ve batma kaynaklı yaralanma riskini minimize eder.
seoDescription: Gıda ve ilaç sektörü için metal dedektöründe algılanabilen makas. 85 mm kesim boyu ve ergonomik sap. Hijyenik ve profesyonel kullanım.

name: SECUPLUS 568
shortDescription:
Endüstriyel makas. Tam güç ileri.
MARTOR’un SECUPLUS 568 makası, lojistik ve imalat alanı için olan bir endüstriyel makastır. Örneğin kalın kartonları, kauçuğu veya kaplamaları bir makasla kesmek istiyorsanız, birinci tercihiniz bu alettir. Güvenlik makası sadece sağlam olmakla kalmıyor, ayrıca 115 mm’lik kesim boyuyla da oldukça verimli. Fazlası var: Çalışırken kesik ve batma kaynaklı yaralanmalardan korunursunuz. Bunun için özel koruma taşlaması ve yuvarlatılmış uçlar var.
seoDescription: Lojistik için endüstriyel makas. 115 mm kesim boyu ile kalın karton ve kaplamaları güvenle keser. Sağlam ve verimli endüstriyel makas.

name: TOOL BELT
shortDescription:
Çalışırken ihtiyaç duyduğunuz her şeyi bir arada tutar.
Aletlerinizi güvenli ve verimli bir şekilde taşımanıza yardımcı olur. Kemeri esnek bir şekilde kemer çantalarımızla, TOOL RETRACTOR ile ve çok daha fazlasıyla donatabilirsiniz. Polyester kayış ve metal bağlantı elemanı, sağlam ve dayanıklı bir ünite oluşturur. ALET KEMERİ özellikle kemer halkaları olmayan tulumlar giyiyorsanız kullanışlıdır. Kemer halkaları varsa, sadece sabitleme ucunu çıkarmanız ve kemeri içinden çekmeniz yeterlidir.
seoDescription: Çalışma aletlerini taşımak için sağlam kemer. Esnek yapısı ile tulumlar ile kullanıma uygundur. Pratik ve dayanıklı iş kemeri.
